column1: # Kleaf toolchain for Samsung's android14-6.1 drop (kernel/build.config.constants: CLANG_VERSION=r487747c).
# Every line: <destination in the workspace> <gitiles project> <commit> [<subdirectory of the project>]
# Projects and paths come from the AOSP kernel manifest branch common-android14-6.1 (default revision
# main-kernel-build-2023), pinned to the commits those branches pointed at on 2026-10-16. Each entry is
# extracted into the destination, so no git metadata and no host bazel/JDK are needed:
# tools/bazel runs prebuilts/bazel with prebuilts/jdk/jdk11 and the clang prebuilt with its own sysroot.
# Kleaf only uses the NDK's sysroot (build/kernel/kleaf/ndk.BUILD), the rest of ndk-r23 is 1.4 GB of unused binaries.
